jv_income_recovery.jv_name: Mapletree Rosewood Data Centre Trust (MRODCT), 50:50 joint venture with Mapletree Investments Pte Ltd; equity-accounted (equity method, Note 21 p168 / accounting policy Note 2.5-2.6).
jv_income_recovery.jv_rows: 13 North American data centres held via MRODCT (10 powered-shell at MIT effective 50%; 3 fully-fitted hyperscale at MIT effective 40% = 50% x MRODCT's 80% interest, Digital Realty holds the other 20% per overview footnote 4 p46). These are the 13 rows with null market_valuation and null net_property_income.
jv_income_recovery.per_property_npi_decision: All 13 MRODCT rows left net_property_income = null. The audited segment note (Note 32, p197) is a CONSOLIDATED statement in which the JV enters ONLY as a single equity-method line 'Share of joint venture's results' (-8,713 $'000, itself inclusive of a ~60,103 $'000 net fair-value loss on investment properties) plus 'Investments in joint venture' 540,329 $'000 in segment assets - it does NOT disclose the JV's net property income and never per property. The per-property portfolio-overview tables (pp44-47) disclose a per-property Gross Revenue for FY23/24 column but NO net-property-income column. No per-property attributable NPI is disclosed anywhere, so no split can be captured without fabrication.

combined_jv_figures_note_21.basis: MRODCT entity level = 100% of the joint venture (NOT MIT's 50% proportionate share; NOT per-property). Summarised statement of comprehensive income, Note 21 'Investment in a joint venture'. Figures in $'000.
combined_jv_figures_note_21.implied_npi_caveat: 42,404 = 66,148 gross revenue less 23,744 property operating expenses. The report does NOT print an explicit 'Net property income' line for the JV, and does NOT disclose MIT's 50% proportionate share of it - do not derive/allocate to rows.

jv_income_recovery.gross_revenue_basis_caveat: Existing per-property gross_revenue for the 13 JV rows was captured from the portfolio-overview tables (pp45,47), whose Gross-Revenue column is footnoted 'Based on MIT's 50% interest ... through MRODCT'. Their sum (95,117 $'000) reconciles to the North-America DC portfolio subtotal 347,232 = consolidated DC-NA segment gross revenue 252,115 (Note 32 p197) + 95,117. However this 95,117 does NOT reconcile to Note 21's 100%-entity JV gross revenue of 66,148 $'000 (MIT's 50% share of that would be ~33k), so the overview 'Gross Revenue' basis for the JV rows is internally inconsistent with the audited JV note. gross_revenue values left UNCHANGED (a genuine per-property gross line exists) and flagged here for the reviewer; NPI intentionally NOT derived from either basis.
